dedupe_keys.name: gisco transport networks airports and ports of europe eurostat

description: Eurostat's GISCO service publishes reference geodata on transport networks. Coverage: airports 2024 (released 8 June 2026, points), airports 2013 and 2006 (points and polygons), all at 1:1 million scale for Europe; ports 2013 (points, world coverage) and ports 2009 (points and polygons, Europe), in the ETRS89 coordinate reference system. Format and access: ZIP downloads per dataset as file geodatabase and shapefile, with GeoPackage for the newer sets. Licence and cost: free; the page sets no specific download rules but refers to Eurostat's general copyright notice and licence provisions, which users must accept. Caveats: attribute lists are not described on the page; the port layers are older. The data locate airport and port nodes for linking Eurostat traffic statistics to places, for multimodal network flow models and for hazard exposure screening of nodes. It relates to Eurostat transport statistics and the GISCO healthcare services layer in the catalogue.
